caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object in the shape of a monkey, rendered in brown and greenish hues. The object appears to be a container or vessel, with the body of the monkey forming the main section and an open, domed lid positioned slightly askew on top of its head. The monkey's face is detailed, with rounded eyes, small ears, and a pronounced muzzle. Its arms are tucked close to its body, and its long tail curves around the base, ending near the front. The surface of the object is textured to suggest fur, and the overall composition is centralized on a plain, light-colored background without any additional objects or scenery. A small signature is visible in the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Cuspidor
